Chat includes its data/view/flow/node/factory/settings closure; Tool includes generic/denied fallback, atomic views, todo-history and standard image child slots. Ordinary question and preset-help presentations reuse official faces and the same question store; plan-review remains official. Quotes and browser original-byte image transfers use public conversation/slot contracts. Plugin README utilities and selected Host compatibility entries are explicitly attributed below. No official package files, module tables or prototypes are modified. Retired per-session web controls and an unavailable Electron native file-drag bridge are not restored.
